description: This file defines a WebSocket plugin adapter for the Focalboard server, handling WebSocket connections, messaging, and broadcasting events related to boards, categories, blocks, and subscriptions within a Mattermost plugin environment.

classes.name: PluginAdapterInterface
classes.description: Interface defining WebSocket plugin adapter methods for handling connections, messaging, and broadcasting events.

classes.name: PluginAdapter
classes.description: Implementation of the WebSocket plugin adapter managing WebSocket clients, subscriptions, and event broadcasting.

methods.name: NewPluginAdapter
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new PluginAdapter instance with dependencies injected.

methods.name: GetListenerByWebConnID
methods.description: Retrieve a PluginAdapterClient by WebSocket connection ID.

methods.name: GetListenersByUserID
methods.description: Retrieve all clients associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: GetListenersByTeam
methods.description: Retrieve all clients subscribed to a specific team.

methods.name: GetListenersByBlock
methods.description: Retrieve all clients subscribed to a specific block.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Add a new client to the listeners map.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Remove a client from all subscription maps and internal state.

methods.name: removeExpiredForUserID
methods.description: Remove inactive clients for a user if they have expired.

methods.name: removeListenerFromTeam
methods.description: Remove a client from a team's subscription list.

methods.name: removeListenerFromBlock
methods.description: Remove a client from a block's subscription list.

methods.name: subscribeListenerToTeam
methods.description: Subscribe a client to a team.

methods.name: unsubscribeListenerFromTeam
methods.description: Unsubscribe a client from a team.

methods.name: getUserIDsForTeam
methods.description: Get list of user IDs with active connections to a team who have access.

methods.name: getUserIDsForTeamAndBoard
methods.description: Get list of user IDs connected to a team and members of a specific board, optionally ensuring certain user IDs are included.

methods.name: OnWebSocketConnect
methods.description: Handle new WebSocket connection, reusing existing or creating new client.

methods.name: OnWebSocketDisconnect
methods.description: Handle WebSocket disconnection, marking client as inactive.

methods.name: commandFromRequest
methods.description: Parse WebSocket request into command structure, extracting action, team ID, read token, and block IDs.

methods.name: WebSocketMessageHasBeenPosted
methods.description: Process incoming WebSocket messages, handling subscription commands.

methods.name: sendMessageToAll
methods.description: Broadcast a message to all connected clients across the cluster.

methods.name: BroadcastConfigChange
methods.description: Broadcast configuration change to all clients.

methods.name: sendUserMessageSkipCluster
methods.description: Send a message to specific users, skipping cluster propagation.

methods.name: sendTeamMessageSkipCluster
methods.description: Send a message to all users subscribed to a team, skipping cluster.

methods.name: sendTeamMessage
methods.description: Send and propagate a message to all users subscribed to a team.

methods.name: sendBoardMessageSkipCluster
methods.description: Send a message to users subscribed to a team and board, skipping cluster.

methods.name: sendBoardMessage
methods.description: Send and propagate a message to users subscribed to a team and board.

methods.name: BroadcastBlockChange
methods.description: Broadcast a block change event to relevant clients.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryChange
methods.description: Broadcast a category change event.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryReorder
methods.description: Broadcast a category reorder event.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryBoardsReorder
methods.description: Broadcast a reorder of category boards.

methods.name: BroadcastCategoryBoardChange
methods.description: Broadcast a change in category boards.

methods.name: BroadcastBlockDelete
methods.description: Broadcast deletion of a block.

methods.name: BroadcastBoardChange
methods.description: Broadcast a board change event.

methods.name: BroadcastBoardDelete
methods.description: Broadcast deletion of a board.

methods.name: BroadcastMemberChange
methods.description: Broadcast a change in board member.

methods.name: BroadcastMemberDelete
methods.description: Broadcast removal of a board member.

methods.name: BroadcastSubscriptionChange
methods.description: Broadcast a change in subscription.

methods.name: BroadcastCardLimitTimestampChange
methods.description: Broadcast an update to the card limit timestamp.
